turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Okay. You didn't answer my question, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone call me before it went in?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? Who entered the zero, and why did nobody call me first?
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
We're not a team, Hale. You entered a zero on my son's essay without calling me, and procedure 4.2 says you call first. Take the zero off, and then tell me what you actually have.
